author: Javipepe
body:
Hello!

I have lately practiced a little bit my video editing skills and decided to put them into practice with some really exciting avicus gameplay footage.

Music is  Kygo - Stole The Show (DARY Remix) Ft. Parson James , which is one of my favorite songs at the moment.



Click here or in the image to watch it. It's about 3:30 minutes and is, at its maximum possibility a 1080p 60fps video; which also took some hours of my time to render :p

I made all of it using Adobe Premiere Pro.

If you like it, please please please leave a comment and a like; as well as a reply on here so more people see it. Peace.

o/
